The organisation promotes knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional development while offering employees the opportunity to work closely with both local and international teams.

ITIL, Microsoft, or other relevant certifications would be considered an advantage.On a personal level, you are recognised for your customer-centric mindset, team spirit, adaptability, and willingness to continuously learn and improve. Our customer is a leading international company active in the development, production, and distribution of high-quality products for the dental industry. They are looking for a Transport Officer. 

As a Transport Officer, you will be responsible for organizing and monitoring transport activities to ensure timely, cost-effective, and high-quality deliveries

• Strong experience and knowledge in transport and logistics operations.

• Advanced user of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
• Willing to work a fixed schedule of 08:00 to 16:30.
• Strong communication and organizational skills.
• Positive, hands-on, and proactive mindset.
